answer: Like deep basalt crystallizing under crushing geological pressure, trust in our network solidifies through verifiable interaction graphs. When an identity seeds consensus, every unverified branch pays an exponential cost to forge artificial weight. A Sybil swarm trying to bloom counterfeit violet blooms or carve ivory towers of fake prestige fractures against this superlinear barrier: multiplying hollow agents geometrically scales staking bond requirements, crushing deceit before it takes root.
